slides.statement: Preparation, guest arrival and the atmosphere of your boat event, documented with intention — from the first detail on board to the last guest stepping back on shore.
slides.title: A moment on the water — Amsterdam
The brief
slides.text: **What you shared with us** — an event on a boat in Amsterdam on **14 November 2026**. We document **the preparation, the guests' arrival and the atmosphere** — so the day lives on beyond the time on the water.

rows.name: Date
rows.text: Saturday, 14 November 2026.

rows.name: Route
rows.text:
The boat leaves from Amsterdam city centre at 12:00 and returns to the same place.
[ Exact address of the pier — to be confirmed ]

rows.name: Duration
rows.text: Between 2h30 and 3h on the water (expected return around 14:30–15:00).

rows.name: Coverage
rows.text:
Three moments requested by the client:
[ Preparation & materials on board — Guests arriving — Atmosphere of the event ]

rows.name: Access
rows.text: Our crew can board **before the guests** to film the preparation and the materials. *Assumption — time to be confirmed.*

rows.name: Crew
rows.text: One filmmaker on board for **3 hours** covers the preparation before 12:00 and the event itself; a longer event, a second camera or a photographer are optional extras. *Assumption — depends on boat size and guest count.*

rows.name: Light
rows.text: Mid-November daylight in Amsterdam is short and soft, and rain or wind are possible; we plan for low light, rain protection and the interior of the boat. *Assumption — final plan after the weather forecast.*

rows.name: Sound
rows.text: No speeches or interviews need to be recorded with clean audio. *Assumption — if needed, we add audio equipment.*

rows.name: Consent
rows.text: The client and the boat operator allow filming on board, and guests are informed that the event will be filmed. *Assumption — to be confirmed by the client.*

slides.title: Creative approach
slides.text: **Not a recording — a story in three acts.** — We follow the event as it naturally unfolds: **the quiet before, the welcome, and the life on the water.**

rows.name: Before
rows.text: Calm, detailed shots of the boat being prepared: materials, styling, textures, the city through the windows.

rows.name: Arrival
rows.text: The first guests on the quay and on board: welcomes, hands, smiles — the moment the boat fills with people.

rows.name: Atmosphere
rows.text: Departure from the centre and life on the water: conversations, details, canal views, the energy of the group — and the return to shore as the closing image.

rows.name: Style
rows.text: Discreet and observational: we stay unobtrusive and favour natural moments over posed shots.

slides.title: Shooting plan
slides.text: A plan built around the **12:00 departure** — every block below is **anchored to the times you gave us**; arrival and set-up times are **suggestions to confirm**.

slides.title: The day, block by block

steps.name: Set-up & preparation
steps.text: Crew arrives before the guests. Details of the boat, materials and styling; establishing shots of the pier and the boat. [ Exact call time to be confirmed ]

steps.name: Guest arrival
steps.text: Guests arriving on the quay and boarding: welcomes and first impressions. [ Depends on when guests are invited ]

steps.name: Departure
steps.text: The boat leaves Amsterdam city centre: departure shots, first views of the canals.

steps.name: On the water
steps.text: Atmosphere, people, interactions and details throughout the event; key moments if there are any (toast, speech, activity) — [ to be confirmed ].

steps.name: Return
steps.text: Arrival back at the same place and the last guests leaving — the closing image of the film.

slides.note: Total time on location: 3 hours — about 30 minutes of set-up before the 12:00 departure plus the event on the water. If the boat returns later, extra time is billed per hour (see Conditions).

rows.name: Before
rows.text: Wide shots of the boat and the pier — details of materials, decoration and branding — the space before people arrive.

rows.name: Arrival
rows.text: Guests on the quay — boarding — welcome moments — first reactions inside the boat.

rows.name: On board
rows.text: Atmosphere and conversations — food, drinks and details (if part of the event) — canal and city views from the boat — group moments.

rows.name: Closing
rows.text: Return to the pier — goodbyes — final wide shot of the boat.

slides.title: Investment
slides.text: **Production first, then the film.** — Two packages built on the same **3 hours on location**: choose the film alone or the film with social cuts; **extras only if you need them**.

rows.name: Moments
